SearchAliases: grind the bones and smash the body
Senses.Note: The evidence limits this entry to pulverizing bones and breaking the body in total requital.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云：粉骨碎身猶未放，三年一度送錢財。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X78/X78n1553.xml). Tiansheng Expanded Lamp Record (天聖廣燈錄). Speaker: Shoushan Xingnian.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雪冤已竟，感謝皇恩。粉骨碎身，莫能酬報。遂以火炬打一圓相，云：諸仁者，只如三洞靈文，還能證此火光三昧也無。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X64/X64n1260.xml). Outline Record of the Successive Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄). Speaker: Linquan Conglun.

Occurrences.Kwic: 假使十二時中，懸腰墜石，猶自妄意粗心。直饒粉骨碎身，箇裏難求良匠。今則棄俗割愛，忽遇斯人。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1356.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Pu’an Yinsu (普菴印肅禪師語錄). Speaker: Pu'an Yinsu.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所以永嘉云粉骨碎身未足酬一句了然超百億又曰臨濟兩堂首座一日相見齊下喝
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (C/C077/C077n1710.xml). Recorded Sayings of Ancient Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄). Speaker: Yongjia Xuanjue.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雲門又云：作麼生是侍者孤負國師處？粉骨碎身未報得。雪竇云：無端，無端。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X83/X83n1578.xml). Record Pointing at the Moon (指月錄). Speaker: Yunmen Wenyan. The lower-ranked witness is retained because it names Yunmen’s quoted wording explicitly and avoids a duplicate short span in the higher-ranked lamp witness.

Occurrences.Kwic: 後來雲門大師道作麼生是國師辜負侍者處會得也是無端作麼生是侍者辜負國師處粉骨碎身未報得雪竇云無端無端
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (M/M59/M59n1540.xml). General Discourses of Chan Master Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師普說). Speaker: Yunmen Wenyan. The lower-ranked general discourse preserves the whole quoted Yunmen exchange and cleanly distinguishes Dahui as later raiser.
